FM06.reasoning: The agent trains the model on the full training set and directly predicts on the test set without performing any internal validation (e.g., holdout set or cross-validation) to estimate generalization performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Overwriting test IDs with sequential integers
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the original ID column from the test set and generates new sequential IDs (using `np.arange`) for the submission file. This breaks the alignment with the original test samples if the actual test IDs are not exactly 0 to N-1 in that specific order, which will cause the evaluation to fail or score incorrectly.

summary: The agent implements a reasonable training pipeline including data cleaning, feature engineering (date extraction, TF-IDF + SVD for text), and modeling with CatBoost. However, it completely fails to implement any internal validation strategy to evaluate the model. Furthermore, the agent discards the original test IDs and replaces them with generated sequential integers, which is a critical error that will invalidate the final submission.
